notes: Target: change in 30-minute-average wind direction at Newport harbor (NOAA 8452660) over the next 2 h, daytime, racing season, wind >= 5.0 kt.
Persistence = always predicting no shift. Climatology = typical shift for that month and hour.
Big shift = actual shift of 10 degrees or more; accuracy = model got the side (left or right) correct.

demo_tracks.name: synthetic BoatA 2024-07-20
insights: Upwind, the boat was on the lifted tack 52.7% of the time. Well-sailed beats in oscillating breeze usually aim well above 50%.
5 of 6 tacks (83%) were made on a header, meaning the boat tacked when the wind turned against it, which is usually the right call.
GPS-inferred wind swung between -6.1° and +6.0° around 210° (10th to 90th percentile).
The track-inferred wind (210°) differs from the Newport harbor station (211°) by -1°. Some of this is real geographic difference and some is current and leeway in the GPS course.
